ocr.notes: Minor errors in round 3 and times

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat printed the London Sporting Life's round-by-round account of Allen's glove fight with Tompkin Gilbert for the English championship; Gilbert left the ring after seven rounds and Allen was declared the winner.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Wednesday Morning, November 21, 1877. Source: London Sporting Life of October 31

facts.fact: Allen beat Tompkin Gilbert in a glove fight for the English championship; Gilbert went down in each round, left the ring after the seventh, and Allen was declared the winner after 16 min 45 sec

notes: Same fight as article 600 (16:25 there, 16:45 here). Here Allen claimed the foul; in 600 Gilbert's seconds did.
